subject.title: feat(gateway): wire read coding tool into HTTP /tools/invoke (narrow)

question: Should OpenClaw expose the built-in host-filesystem `read` tool through Gateway HTTP and SDK RPC direct invocation when both config gates are enabled and the sender is owner/admin?
rationale: The patch intentionally expands authenticated Gateway data access and establishes a permanent operator-facing config/API contract; code correctness alone cannot decide whether host-wide reads belong on this surface.

options.title: Accept the triple gate
options.body: Approve the default-off owner-only design after current-runtime live proof confirms the full resolver and plugin-collision behavior.

options.title: Require workspace confinement
options.body: Approve direct-invoke reading only when workspace confinement is enforced rather than merely recommended.

options.title: Keep built-in read unavailable
options.body: Reject this core capability and retain direct invocation only for existing tools and separately owned plugin tools.

recommendation.title: Accept the triple gate
recommendation.body: Approve the default-off owner-only design after current-runtime live proof confirms the full resolver and plugin-collision behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev is connected to the shared direct-invocation boundary and was explicitly asked to make the security-direction judgment.
